vulg: Paulus servus Dei apostolus autem Iesu Christi secundum fidem electorum Dei et agnitionem veritatis quae secundum pietatem est
clem: Paulus servus Dei, Apostolus autem Jesu Christi secundum fidem electorum Dei, et agnitionem veritatis, qu secundum pietatem est
tr: παυλος δουλος θεου αποστολος δε ιησου χριστου κατα πιστιν εκλεκτων θεου και επιγνωσιν αληθειας της κατ ευσεβειαν
kjv: Paul, a servant of God, and an apostle of Jesus Christ, according to the faith of God's elect, and the acknowledging of the truth which is after godliness;

vulg: in spem vitae aeternae quam promisit qui non mentitur Deus ante tempora saecularia
clem: in spem vit tern, quam promisit qui non mentitur, Deus, ante tempora scularia:
tr: επ ελπιδι ζωης αιωνιου ην επηγγειλατο ο αψευδης θεος προ χρονων αιωνιων
kjv: In hope of eternal life, which God, that cannot lie, promised before the world began;

vulg: manifestavit autem temporibus suis verbum suum in praedicatione quae credita est mihi secundum praeceptum salvatoris nostri Dei
clem: manifestavit autem temporibus suis verbum suum in prdicatione, qu credita est mihi secundum prceptum Salvatoris nostri Dei:
tr: εφανερωσεν δε καιροις ιδιοις τον λογον αυτου εν κηρυγματι ο επιστευθην εγω κατ επιταγην του σωτηρος ημων θεου
kjv: But hath in due times manifested his word through preaching, which is committed unto me according to the commandment of God our Saviour;

vulg: Tito dilecto filio secundum communem fidem gratia et pax a Deo Patre et Christo Iesu salvatore nostro
clem: Tito dilecto filio secundum communem fidem, gratia, et pax a Deo Patre, et Christo Jesu Salvatore nostro.
tr: τιτω γνησιω τεκνω κατα κοινην πιστιν χαρις ελεος ειρηνη απο θεου πατρος και κυριου ιησου χριστου του σωτηρος ημων
kjv: To Titus, mine own son after the common faith: Grace, mercy, and peace, from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ our Saviour.

vulg: huius rei gratia reliqui te Cretae ut ea quae desunt corrigas et constituas per civitates presbyteros sicut ego tibi disposui
clem: Hujus rei gratia reliqui te Cret, ut ea qu desunt, corrigas, et constituas per civitates presbyteros, sicut et ego disposui tibi,
tr: τουτου χαριν κατελιπον σε εν κρητη ινα τα λειποντα επιδιορθωση και καταστησης κατα πολιν πρεσβυτερους ως εγω σοι διεταξαμην
kjv: For this cause left I thee in Crete, that thou shouldest set in order the things that are wanting, and ordain elders in every city, as I had appointed thee:

vulg: si quis sine crimine est unius uxoris vir filios habens fideles non in accusatione luxuriae aut non subditos
clem: si quis sine crimine est, unius uxoris vir, filios habens fideles, non in accusatione luxuri, aut non subditos.
tr: ει τις εστιν ανεγκλητος μιας γυναικος ανηρ τεκνα εχων πιστα μη εν κατηγορια ασωτιας η ανυποτακτα
kjv: If any be blameless, the husband of one wife, having faithful children not accused of riot or unruly.

vulg: oportet enim episcopum sine crimine esse sicut Dei dispensatorem non superbum non iracundum non vinolentum non percussorem non turpilucri cupidum
clem: Oportet enim episcopum sine crimine esse, sicut Dei dispensatorem: non superbum, non iracundum, non vinolentum, non percussorem, non turpis lucri cupidum:
tr: δει γαρ τον επισκοπον ανεγκλητον ειναι ως θεου οικονομον μη αυθαδη μη οργιλον μη παροινον μη πληκτην μη αισχροκερδη
kjv: For a bishop must be blameless, as the steward of God; not selfwilled, not soon angry, not given to wine, no striker, not given to filthy lucre;

vulg: sed hospitalem benignum sobrium iustum sanctum continentem
clem: sed hospitalem, benignum, sobrium, justum, sanctum, continentem,
tr: αλλα φιλοξενον φιλαγαθον σωφρονα δικαιον οσιον εγκρατη
kjv: But a lover of hospitality, a lover of good men, sober, just, holy, temperate;

vulg: amplectentem eum qui secundum doctrinam est fidelem sermonem ut potens sit et exhortari in doctrina sana et eos qui contradicunt arguere
clem: amplectentem eum, qui secundum doctrinam est, fidelem sermonem: ut potens sit exhortari in doctrina sana, et eos qui contradicunt, arguere.
tr: αντεχομενον του κατα την διδαχην πιστου λογου ινα δυνατος η και παρακαλειν εν τη διδασκαλια τη υγιαινουση και τους αντιλεγοντας ελεγχειν
kjv: Holding fast the faithful word as he hath been taught, that he may be able by sound doctrine both to exhort and to convince the gainsayers.

vulg: sunt enim multi et inoboedientes vaniloqui et seductores maxime qui de circumcisione sunt
clem: Sunt enim multi etiam inobedientes, vaniloqui, et seductores: maxime qui de circumcisione sunt:
tr: εισιν γαρ πολλοι και ανυποτακτοι ματαιολογοι και φρεναπαται μαλιστα οι εκ περιτομης
kjv: For there are many unruly and vain talkers and deceivers, specially they of the circumcision:

vulg: quos oportet redargui qui universas domos subvertunt docentes quae non oportet turpis lucri gratia
clem: quos oportet redargui: qui universas domos subvertunt, docentes qu non oportet, turpis lucri gratia.
tr: ους δει επιστομιζειν οιτινες ολους οικους ανατρεπουσιν διδασκοντες α μη δει αισχρου κερδους χαριν
kjv: Whose mouths must be stopped, who subvert whole houses, teaching things which they ought not, for filthy lucre's sake.

vulg: dixit quidam ex illis proprius ipsorum propheta Cretenses semper mendaces malae bestiae ventres pigri
clem: Dixit quidam ex illis, proprius ipsorum propheta: Cretenses semper mendaces, mal besti, ventres pigri.
tr: ειπεν τις εξ αυτων ιδιος αυτων προφητης κρητες αει ψευσται κακα θηρια γαστερες αργαι
kjv: One of themselves, even a prophet of their own, said, the Cretians are alway liars, evil beasts, slow bellies.

vulg: testimonium hoc verum est quam ob causam increpa illos dure ut sani sint in fide
clem: Testimonium hoc verum est. Quam ob causam increpa illos dure, ut sani sint in fide,
tr: η μαρτυρια αυτη εστιν αληθης δι ην αιτιαν ελεγχε αυτους αποτομως ινα υγιαινωσιν εν τη πιστει
kjv: This witness is true. Wherefore rebuke them sharply, that they may be sound in the faith;

vulg: non intendentes iudaicis fabulis et mandatis hominum aversantium se a veritate
clem: non intendentes judaicis fabulis, et mandatis hominum, aversantium se a veritate.
tr: μη προσεχοντες ιουδαικοις μυθοις και εντολαις ανθρωπων αποστρεφομενων την αληθειαν
kjv: Not giving heed to Jewish fables, and commandments of men, that turn from the truth.

vulg: omnia munda mundis coinquinatis autem et infidelibus nihil mundum sed inquinatae sunt eorum et mens et conscientia
clem: Omnia munda mundis: coinquinatis autem et infidelibus, nihil est mundum, sed inquinat sunt eorum et mens et conscientia.
tr: παντα μεν καθαρα τοις καθαροις τοις δε μεμιασμενοις και απιστοις ουδεν καθαρον αλλα μεμιανται αυτων και ο νους και η συνειδησις
kjv: Unto the pure all things are pure: but unto them that are defiled and unbelieving is nothing pure; but even their mind and conscience is defiled.

vulg: confitentur se nosse Deum factis autem negant cum sunt abominati et incredibiles et ad omne opus bonum reprobi
clem: Confitentur se nosse Deum, factis autem negant: cum sint abominati, et incredibiles, et ad omne opus bonum reprobi.
tr: θεον ομολογουσιν ειδεναι τοις δε εργοις αρνουνται βδελυκτοι οντες και απειθεις και προς παν εργον αγαθον αδοκιμοι
kjv: They profess that they know God; but in works they deny him, being abominable, and disobedient, and unto every good work reprobate.

vulg: tu autem loquere quae decet sanam doctrinam
clem: Tu autem loquere qu decent sanam doctrinam:
tr: συ δε λαλει α πρεπει τη υγιαινουση διδασκαλια
kjv: But speak thou the things which become sound doctrine:

vulg: senes ut sobrii sint pudici prudentes sani fide dilectione patientia
clem: senes ut sobrii sint, pudici, prudentes, sani in fide, in dilectione, in patientia:
tr: πρεσβυτας νηφαλιους ειναι σεμνους σωφρονας υγιαινοντας τη πιστει τη αγαπη τη υπομονη
kjv: That the aged men be sober, grave, temperate, sound in faith, in charity, in patience.

vulg: anus similiter in habitu sancto non criminatrices non vino multo servientes bene docentes
clem: anus similiter in habitu sancto, non criminatrices, non multo vino servientes, bene docentes:
tr: πρεσβυτιδας ωσαυτως εν καταστηματι ιεροπρεπεις μη διαβολους μη οινω πολλω δεδουλωμενας καλοδιδασκαλους
kjv: The aged women likewise, that they be in behaviour as becometh holiness, not false accusers, not given to much wine, teachers of good things;

vulg: ut prudentiam doceant adulescentulas ut viros suos ament filios diligant
clem: ut prudentiam doceant adolescentulas, ut viros suos ament, filios suos diligant,
tr: ινα σωφρονιζωσιν τας νεας φιλανδρους ειναι φιλοτεκνους
kjv: That they may teach the young women to be sober, to love their husbands, to love their children,

vulg: prudentes castas domus curam habentes benignas subditas suis viris ut non blasphemetur verbum Dei
clem: prudentes, castas, sobrias, domus curam habentes, benignas, subditas viris suis, ut non blasphemetur verbum Dei.
tr: σωφρονας αγνας οικουρους αγαθας υποτασσομενας τοις ιδιοις ανδρασιν ινα μη ο λογος του θεου βλασφημηται
kjv: To be discreet, chaste, keepers at home, good, obedient to their own husbands, that the word of God be not blasphemed.

vulg: iuvenes similiter hortare ut sobrii sint
clem: Juvenes similiter hortare ut sobrii sint.
tr: τους νεωτερους ωσαυτως παρακαλει σωφρονειν
kjv: Young men likewise exhort to be sober minded.

vulg: in omnibus te ipsum praebe exemplum bonorum operum in doctrina integritatem gravitatem
clem: In omnibus teipsum prbe exemplum bonorum operum, in doctrina, in integritate, in gravitate,
tr: περι παντα σεαυτον παρεχομενος τυπον καλων εργων εν τη διδασκαλια αδιαφθοριαν σεμνοτητα αφθαρσιαν
kjv: In all things shewing thyself a pattern of good works: in doctrine shewing uncorruptness, gravity, sincerity,

vulg: verbum sanum inreprehensibilem ut is qui ex adverso est vereatur nihil habens malum dicere de nobis
clem: verbum sanum, irreprehensibile: ut is qui ex adverso est, vereatur, nihil habens malum dicere de nobis.
tr: λογον υγιη ακαταγνωστον ινα ο εξ εναντιας εντραπη μηδεν εχων περι υμων λεγειν φαυλον
kjv: Sound speech, that cannot be condemned; that he that is of the contrary part may be ashamed, having no evil thing to say of you.

vulg: servos dominis suis subditos esse in omnibus placentes non contradicentes
clem: Servos dominis suis subditos esse, in omnibus placentes, non contradicentes,
tr: δουλους ιδιοις δεσποταις υποτασσεσθαι εν πασιν ευαρεστους ειναι μη αντιλεγοντας
kjv: Exhort servants to be obedient unto their own masters, and to please them well in all things; not answering again;

vulg: non fraudantes, sed in omnibus fidem bonam ostendentes ut doctrinam salutaris nostri Dei ornent in omnibus
clem: non fraudantes, sed in omnibus fidem bonam ostendentes: ut doctrinam Salvatoris nostri Dei ornent in omnibus.
tr: μη νοσφιζομενους αλλα πιστιν πασαν ενδεικνυμενους αγαθην ινα την διδασκαλιαν του σωτηρος υμων  ημων  θεου κοσμωσιν εν πασιν
kjv: Not purloining, but shewing all good fidelity; that they may adorn the doctrine of God our Saviour in all things.

vulg: apparuit enim gratia Dei salutaris omnibus hominibus
clem: Apparuit enim gratia Dei Salvatoris nostri omnibus hominibus,
tr: επεφανη γαρ η χαρις του θεου η σωτηριος πασιν ανθρωποις
kjv: For the grace of God that bringeth salvation hath appeared to all men,

vulg: erudiens nos ut abnegantes impietatem et saecularia desideria sobrie et iuste et pie vivamus in hoc saeculo
clem: erudiens nos, ut abnegantes impietatem, et scularia desideria, sobrie, et juste, et pie vivamus in hoc sculo,
tr: παιδευουσα ημας ινα αρνησαμενοι την ασεβειαν και τας κοσμικας επιθυμιας σωφρονως και δικαιως και ευσεβως ζησωμεν εν τω νυν αιωνι
kjv: Teaching us that, denying ungodliness and worldly lusts, we should live soberly, righteously, and godly, in this present world;

vulg: expectantes beatam spem et adventum gloriae magni Dei et salvatoris nostri Iesu Christi
clem: exspectantes beatam spem, et adventum glori magni Dei, et Salvatoris nostri Jesu Christi:
tr: προσδεχομενοι την μακαριαν ελπιδα και επιφανειαν της δοξης του μεγαλου θεου και σωτηρος ημων ιησου χριστου
kjv: Looking for that blessed hope, and the glorious appearing of the great God and our Saviour Jesus Christ;

vulg: qui dedit semet ipsum pro nobis ut nos redimeret ab omni iniquitate et mundaret sibi populum acceptabilem sectatorem bonorum operum
clem: qui dedit semetipsum pro nobis, ut nos redimeret ab omni iniquitate, et mundaret sibi populum acceptabilem, sectatorem bonorum operum.
tr: ος εδωκεν εαυτον υπερ ημων ινα λυτρωσηται ημας απο πασης ανομιας και καθαριση εαυτω λαον περιουσιον ζηλωτην καλων εργων
kjv: Who gave himself for us, that he might redeem us from all iniquity, and purify unto himself a peculiar people, zealous of good works.

vulg: haec loquere et exhortare et argue cum omni imperio nemo te contemnat
clem: Hc loquere, et exhortare, et argue cum omni imperio. Nemo te contemnat.
tr: ταυτα λαλει και παρακαλει και ελεγχε μετα πασης επιταγης μηδεις σου περιφρονειτω
kjv: These things speak, and exhort, and rebuke with all authority. Let no man despise thee.

vulg: admone illos principibus et potestatibus subditos esse dicto oboedire ad omne opus bonum paratos esse
clem: Admone illos principibus, et potestatibus subditos esse, dicto obedire, ad omne opus bonum paratos esse:
tr: υπομιμνησκε αυτους αρχαις και εξουσιαις υποτασσεσθαι πειθαρχειν προς παν εργον αγαθον ετοιμους ειναι
kjv: Put them in mind to be subject to principalities and powers, to obey magistrates, to be ready to every good work,

vulg: neminem blasphemare non litigiosos esse modestos omnem ostendentes mansuetudinem ad omnes homines
clem: neminem blasphemare, non litigiosos esse, sed modestos, omnem ostendentes mansuetudinem ad omnes homines.
tr: μηδενα βλασφημειν αμαχους ειναι επιεικεις πασαν ενδεικνυμενους πραοτητα προς παντας ανθρωπους
kjv: To speak evil of no man, to be no brawlers, but gentle, shewing all meekness unto all men.

vulg: eramus enim et nos aliquando insipientes increduli errantes servientes desideriis et voluptatibus variis in malitia et invidia agentes odibiles odientes invicem
clem: Eramus enim aliquando et nos insipientes, increduli, errantes, servientes desideriis, et voluptatibus variis, in malitia et invidia agentes, odibiles, odientes invicem.
tr: ημεν γαρ ποτε και ημεις ανοητοι απειθεις πλανωμενοι δουλευοντες επιθυμιαις και ηδοναις ποικιλαις εν κακια και φθονω διαγοντες στυγητοι μισουντες αλληλους
kjv: For we ourselves also were sometimes foolish, disobedient, deceived, serving divers lusts and pleasures, living in malice and envy, hateful, and hating one another.

vulg: cum autem benignitas et humanitas apparuit salvatoris nostri Dei
clem: Cum autem benignitas et humanitas apparuit Salvatoris nostri Dei,
tr: οτε δε η χρηστοτης και η φιλανθρωπια επεφανη του σωτηρος ημων θεου
kjv: But after that the kindness and love of God our Saviour toward man appeared,

vulg: non ex operibus iustitiae quae fecimus nos sed secundum suam misericordiam salvos nos fecit per lavacrum regenerationis et renovationis Spiritus Sancti
clem: non ex operibus justiti, qu fecimus nos, sed secundum suam misericordiam salvos nos fecit per lavacrum regenerationis et renovationis Spiritus Sancti,
tr: ουκ εξ εργων των εν δικαιοσυνη ων εποιησαμεν ημεις αλλα κατα τον αυτου ελεον εσωσεν ημας δια λουτρου παλιγγενεσιας και ανακαινωσεως πνευματος αγιου
kjv: Not by works of righteousness which we have done, but according to his mercy he saved us, by the washing of regeneration, and renewing of the Holy Ghost;

vulg: quem effudit in nos abunde per Iesum Christum salvatorem nostrum
clem: quem effudit in nos abunde per Jesum Christum Salvatorem nostrum:
tr: ου εξεχεεν εφ ημας πλουσιως δια ιησου χριστου του σωτηρος ημων
kjv: Which he shed on us abundantly through Jesus Christ our Saviour;

vulg: ut iustificati gratia ipsius heredes simus secundum spem vitae aeternae
clem: ut justificati gratia ipsius, hredes simus secundum spem vit tern.
tr: ινα δικαιωθεντες τη εκεινου χαριτι κληρονομοι γενωμεθα κατ ελπιδα ζωης αιωνιου
kjv: That being justified by his grace, we should be made heirs according to the hope of eternal life.

vulg: fidelis sermo est et de his volo te confirmare ut curent bonis operibus praeesse qui credunt Deo haec sunt bona et utilia hominibus
clem: Fidelis sermo est: et de his volo te confirmare: ut curent bonis operibus presse qui credunt Deo. Hc sunt bona, et utilia hominibus.
tr: πιστος ο λογος και περι τουτων βουλομαι σε διαβεβαιουσθαι ινα φροντιζωσιν καλων εργων προιστασθαι οι πεπιστευκοτες τω θεω ταυτα εστιν τα καλα και ωφελιμα τοις ανθρωποις
kjv: This is a faithful saying, and these things I will that thou affirm constantly, that they which have believed in God might be careful to maintain good works. These things are good and profitable unto men.

vulg: stultas autem quaestiones et genealogias et contentiones et pugnas legis devita sunt enim inutiles et vanae
clem: Stultas autem qustiones, et genealogias, et contentiones, et pugnas legis devita: sunt enim inutiles, et van.
tr: μωρας δε ζητησεις και γενεαλογιας και ερεις και μαχας νομικας περιιστασο εισιν γαρ ανωφελεις και ματαιοι
kjv: But avoid foolish questions, and genealogies, and contentions, and strivings about the law; for they are unprofitable and vain.

vulg: hereticum hominem post unam et secundam correptionem devita
clem: Hreticum hominem post unam et secundam correptionem devita:
tr: αιρετικον ανθρωπον μετα μιαν και δευτεραν νουθεσιαν παραιτου
kjv: A man that is an heretick after the first and second admonition reject;

vulg: sciens quia subversus est qui eiusmodi est et delinquit proprio iudicio condemnatus
clem: sciens quia subversus est, qui ejusmodi est, et delinquit, cum sit proprio judicio condemnatus.
tr: ειδως οτι εξεστραπται ο τοιουτος και αμαρτανει ων αυτοκατακριτος
kjv: Knowing that he that is such is subverted, and sinneth, being condemned of himself.

vulg: cum misero ad te Arteman aut Tychicum festina ad me venire Nicopolim ibi enim statui hiemare
clem: Cum misero ad te Artemam, aut Tychicum, festina ad me venire Nicopolim: ibi enim statui hiemare.
tr: οταν πεμψω αρτεμαν προς σε η τυχικον σπουδασον ελθειν προς με εις νικοπολιν εκει γαρ κεκρικα παραχειμασαι
kjv: When I shall send Artemas unto thee, or Tychicus, be diligent to come unto me to Nicopolis: for I have determined there to winter.

vulg: Zenan legis peritum et Apollo sollicite praemitte ut nihil illis desit
clem: Zenam legisperitum et Apollo sollicite prmitte, ut nihil illis desit.
tr: ζηναν τον νομικον και απολλω σπουδαιως προπεμψον ινα μηδεν αυτοις λειπη
kjv: Bring Zenas the lawyer and Apollos on their journey diligently, that nothing be wanting unto them.

vulg: discant autem et nostri bonis operibus praeesse ad usus necessarios ut non sint infructuosi
clem: Discant autem et nostri bonis operibus presse ad usus necessarios: ut non sint infructuosi.
tr: μανθανετωσαν δε και οι ημετεροι καλων εργων προιστασθαι εις τας αναγκαιας χρειας ινα μη ωσιν ακαρποι
kjv: And let our's also learn to maintain good works for necessary uses, that they be not unfruitful.

vulg: salutant te qui mecum sunt omnes saluta qui nos amant in fide gratia Dei cum omnibus vobis amen
clem: Salutant te qui mecum sunt omnes: saluta eos qui nos amant in fide. Gratia Dei cum omnibus vobis. Amen.
tr: ασπαζονται σε οι μετ εμου παντες ασπασαι τους φιλουντας ημας εν πιστει η χαρις μετα παντων υμων αμην [ προς τιτον της κρητων εκκλησιας πρωτον επισκοπον χειροτονηθεντα εγραφη απο νικοπολεως της μακεδονιας]
kjv: All that are with me salute thee. Greet them that love us in the faith. Grace be with you all. Amen.
